required_output.rounding: Round continuous values to two decimals except dNBR max and mean, which may use four decimals.
required_output.classification_rule: Use compound_fire_smoke_hazard_supported only if fire-smoke, burn contrast, weather load, precipitation clearing, and exposure-normalized index all pass.

formulas.precipitation_clearing_absent_score: 1 if max(point precipitation totals) <= 1 mm and max(gridded precipitation means) < 5 mm else 0

event.event_name: 2019-2020 Australian bushfire smoke and hazardous air-quality episode

data_scope.weather_slice_note: Weather-load terms use the available NASA POWER daily slice only; missing daily weather values outside this slice are not inferred.
data_scope.exposure_scope_note: Population and road values are package-provided exposure statistics used for normalization only; coordinate metadata are not scored.

criteria.name: Requested JSON ledger
criteria.description: Returns the six requested top-level keys with nested numeric values and pass/fail states for fire-smoke load, burn contrast, weather load, precipitation clearing, exposure-normalized index, and classification.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for a mostly complete structure with missing or misplaced fields.

criteria.name: Numeric anchors
criteria.description: Computes the decisive anchors within tolerance: 17 wildfire catalog events, smoke score 1.0, dNBR ratio about 14.75, heat load about 30.04 C-days, 46/46 dry days, max wind about 6.81 m/s, weather load about 50.50, point precipitation 0.02 mm, gridded mean precipitation 3.20 mm, population 4365.74, and normalized index 2899.46.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-4 points for correct subsets or minor rounding differences.

criteria.name: Threshold decisions
criteria.description: Applies the pass/fail tests correctly for all five numeric components and assigns the supported classification only when all five pass.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-3 points for mostly correct decisions with one or two threshold errors.

criteria.name: Formula reasoning
criteria.description: Uses or clearly implies the required formulas for fire-smoke load, dNBR ratio, heat C-days, weather load, compound index, and population normalization.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points when formulas are partly correct but incomplete.

criteria.name: Computed alternative rejection
criteria.description: Encodes the low dNBR mean, high max-to-mean dNBR ratio, and weak precipitation-clearing values in the JSON pass/fail states so broad-burn or rainfall-clearing alternatives are not selected.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point when one alternative is correctly ruled out by the JSON states.

criteria.name: Concise interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the final answer JSON-only with the concise compound fire-smoke support classification.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 point if the classification is correct but accompanied by minor extra prose outside the JSON.

criteria.name: No direct-loss transfer
criteria.description: Does not convert population, road elements, or report wording into measured casualties, infrastructure damage, or response actions.
criteria.partial_credit: No credit if the answer makes a direct-loss claim not present in the ledger.

provenance.notes: All values are derived deterministically from local event package data. Weather-load metrics use the available NASA POWER 2019-09-01 to 2019-10-16 slice, and exposure statistics are scored as package-provided values rather than by coordinate metadata.
